paragraphs: Static leaderboard for the public form-field-vlm-benchmark. Models are ranked by typed-field F1 at IoU 0.5. The leaderboard also reports paired IoU 0.5 / 0.2 Box F1 and Box Recall so tight localization, false detections, and field coverage remain distinguishable. Cloud entries show the model generation returned by the evaluated batch. Gemini resolved to 3.1 Flash-Lite, 3.5 Flash, and 3.1 Pro Preview. Details retain both each returned modelversion and the submitted gemini--latest alias.

Systems using FF-DETR / CommonForms by jbarrow, Apache-2.0, use it only for object detection and box localization. It does not provide labels, fine field types, values, or radio-group links; those semantic outputs come from the Nutrient VLM. Benchmark pages derive from CommonForms under CC-BY-4.0.

This project is maintained and funded by Nutrient - The deterministic document infrastructure enterprises run their highest-stakes workflows on: replayable output, clear exceptions, and full audit trails on the messy, regulated documents where AI alone breaks.
